Loss report: gitlab -> concourse
[lost] pipeline/gitlab-ci/trigger/0 trigger.filter.branches (the push trigger has no branch filter, and a git resource follows one branch; the resource follows the default branch of the repository)
[emulated] pipeline/gitlab-ci ext.passthrough: git-uri variable (the git resources read their uri from ((git-uri)); set it with fly set-pipeline -v git-uri=<uri> or in the credential manager)
[emulated] pipeline/gitlab-ci/job/compile trigger.push: workspace from the first triggering resource (the tasks run in the checkout of source, and every build uses the newest version of each resource, so a push to source-tags builds the newest commit of source)
[emulated] pipeline/gitlab-ci/job/compile/step/script step.image: default image (the task names no image, so it runs ubuntu:latest)
[emulated] pipeline/gitlab-ci/job/compile/step/script step.shell: run.path sh with a bash-if-present wrapper (the source runs the step under bash when the image has it; the task runs bash -e when the image has bash, else sh -e, so bash-only syntax fails under sh)
[emulated] pipeline/gitlab-ci/job/lint trigger.push: workspace from the first triggering resource (the tasks run in the checkout of source, and every build uses the newest version of each resource, so a push to source-tags builds the newest commit of source)
[emulated] pipeline/gitlab-ci/job/lint/step/script step.image: default image (the task names no image, so it runs ubuntu:latest)
[emulated] pipeline/gitlab-ci/job/lint/step/script step.shell: run.path sh with a bash-if-present wrapper (the source runs the step under bash when the image has it; the task runs bash -e when the image has bash, else sh -e, so bash-only syntax fails under sh)
[emulated] pipeline/gitlab-ci/job/ship/step/script step.image: default image (the task names no image, so it runs ubuntu:latest)
[emulated] pipeline/gitlab-ci/job/ship/step/script step.shell: run.path sh with a bash-if-present wrapper (the source runs the step under bash when the image has it; the task runs bash -e when the image has bash, else sh -e, so bash-only syntax fails under sh)
[emulated] pipeline/gitlab-ci/job/unit/step/script step.image: default image (the task names no image, so it runs ubuntu:latest)
[emulated] pipeline/gitlab-ci/job/unit/step/script step.shell: run.path sh with a bash-if-present wrapper (the source runs the step under bash when the image has it; the task runs bash -e when the image has bash, else sh -e, so bash-only syntax fails under sh)
[emulated] pipeline/gitlab-ci/trigger/1 trigger.tag: git resource with source.tag_filter (a tag trigger that also has a branch filter is lost, because one git resource cannot hold both sets)
